Camarines Sur under red alert as LPA nears

READ | Camarines Sur has been placed under red alert as a low-pressure area (LPA) threatens to bring heavy rainfall and possible flooding.

Governor Luis Raymund “Lray” Villafuerte announced that the heightened alert took effect at 5 a.m. Monday, following the directive of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (PDRRMC) as part of preemptive safety measures.

“With the declaration of red alert, all local DRRM councils and response agencies are directed to activate their emergency protocols and operate on a 24/7 basis,” Villafuerte said in a statement. | Rex Espiritu

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
